meta.note: What is known (with source), what is missing, and how to get it. Status: Answered / Partial / Open / Blocked.

questions.question: How do we access the Kalshi demo account to read the portfolio and place trades?
questions.known: Portfolio, order and fill endpoints require signed requests using KALSHI-ACCESS-KEY, KALSHI-ACCESS-TIMESTAMP and KALSHI-ACCESS-SIGNATURE. Keys are created on a logged-in Kalshi account (Account Settings, or POST /trade-api/v2/api_keys). The demo environment has its own credentials. Source: https://docs.kalshi.com/getting_started/api_keys
questions.missing: A demo API key pair. No credentials were available to this session and none were requested or stored.
questions.how_to_get: The owner creates a demo API key on demo.kalshi.co and provides it through a secure channel (never in the repo or chat). Until then the portfolio and trade-execution sections stay blocked.

questions.question: How should 'highest dollar amount' be measured?
questions.known: The series and market responses report volume_fp as a count of contracts. No dollar-volume field was found. Source: https://external-api.demo.kalshi.co/trade-api/v2/series?category=Crypto&include_volume=true
questions.missing: A decision on the metric: contract count, or a dollar figure derived from trades.
questions.how_to_get: Owner decides. A dollar figure would be a labelled estimate built from trade prices (GET trades endpoint, not yet read); it would not be shown as an official value.

questions.question: Is there a live gasoline price market on the demo API?
questions.known: Only DIESEL (weekly) and DIESELM (monthly) returned under tags=Gas. Both have 0.00 volume. DIESEL returned no markets. Source: https://external-api.demo.kalshi.co/trade-api/v2/series?tags=Gas&include_volume=true
questions.missing: Gasoline series ticker(s), if any; markets for DIESELM.
questions.how_to_get: Page the Economics series list (category=Economics) and filter titles for gasoline; query /markets?series_ticker=DIESELM.

questions.question: Which golf markets are open and liquid right now?
questions.known: Open: 3 head-to-head markets (0 volume), 3 Ryder Cup markets (stale, updated 2026-04-28), 0 open for KXPGATOP40. Source: https://external-api.demo.kalshi.co/trade-api/v2/markets?series_ticker=KXPGAH2H&status=open&limit=3
questions.missing: The full golf series list (27 pages) and the other golf series' open markets.
questions.how_to_get: Page /series?tags=Golf and query each series' open markets.

questions.question: Which markets are in the highest-volume live set across all five focus topics?
questions.known: Among series checked in this snapshot, KXPGATOP40 has the highest series volume (1,791,408 contracts) but no open markets. Among open markets checked, Poland Sejm (PIS 21,294 contracts) is highest. Source: snapshot.json.
questions.missing: Full paging for Golf (27 pages), Crypto (36) and Elections (529). Open markets for most series not yet checked.
questions.how_to_get: Run the live dashboard (it pages by series) or extend the snapshot script.

questions.question: Do demo prices reflect real markets?
questions.known: Kalshi's demo docs say demo prices and behaviour 'may not be reflective of those in real markets'. Source: https://docs.kalshi.com/getting_started/demo_env
questions.missing: A comparison with production prices for the same tickers.
questions.how_to_get: Decide whether to read the public production market data as a benchmark (see Suggestion SG-09). Do not treat demo prices as production signals.

questions.question: Can the GitHub Pages dashboard read the demo API from a visitor's browser?
questions.known: Not verified. The build sandbox cannot reach the demo API (SSL error from the shell). Source: this session's bash test.
questions.missing: Browser test of CORS and of request limits from the published origin.
questions.how_to_get: Open the published dashboard. If live calls fail, it shows the verified snapshot and a notice.

questions.question: What granularity is needed for the price chart: seconds, minutes or hours?
questions.known: REST candlesticks support 1-minute, 1-hour and 1-day periods only. Seconds need the WebSocket API. Source: https://docs.kalshi.com/api-reference/market/get-market-candlesticks.md
questions.missing: The owner's choice of granularity and whether a WebSocket feed is wanted.

questions.question: What do the contract terms say for each series' settlement?
questions.known: Several settlement-source lists have publisher/URL mismatches or unrelated sources (flags F-05, F-06, F-11). Each series links a contract terms PDF on assets.kalshi.com. Source: snapshot.json.
questions.missing: The text of each contract terms PDF (not read).
questions.how_to_get: Read the contract_terms_url for each series and record the official settlement source there.

questions.question: Are the Poland Sejm quotes coherent, and what is the real price?
questions.known: Last prices sum to 1.06; yes bids sum to 0.06; yes asks sum to 2.93 across three mutually exclusive outcomes. Source: flag F-15.
questions.missing: Deeper order books and trade history for all three markets.
questions.how_to_get: Pull /markets/{ticker}/orderbook and the trades endpoint for each market.

questions.question: Is KXDOGEPERP inside the scope of this demo?
questions.known: It sits in the Crypto event-contract list but looks like a perpetual product (flag F-04). Kalshi documents perps as a separate API (Perps APIs, docs.kalshi.com/margin).
questions.missing: Confirmation of its product type and whether it belongs in the event-contract dashboard.
questions.how_to_get: Read the perps documentation and the series' metadata.

questions.question: What fees apply to the trades we would analyze?
questions.known: Every series returned fee_type 'quadratic' and fee_multiplier 1. The fee schedule is referenced at kalshi.com/docs/kalshi-fee-schedule.pdf (not read). Source: series API responses.
questions.missing: Fee amounts from the fee schedule; needed before any P&L analysis.
questions.how_to_get: Read the fee schedule PDF and the fee rounding doc (https://docs.kalshi.com/getting_started/fee_rounding.md).

questions.question: What risk limits and position sizes should trades follow?
questions.known: Nothing in the brief specifies limits. The docs describe order groups for automatic cancellation based on contract limits (https://docs.kalshi.com/getting_started/order_groups.md).
questions.missing: A risk budget, maximum position size and stop rules for demo trading.
questions.how_to_get: Owner decides before any order is placed (see Suggestion SG-04).

questions.question: What counts as a 'live event'?
questions.known: The API reports market status (active, finalized) and open/close times. Source: markets responses.
questions.missing: The owner's definition: markets with status active only, or also markets already past their expected expiration.
questions.how_to_get: Owner decides. The dashboard currently uses status=open.

questions.question: Which live events have the highest dollar amount in each target category (gas, elections, culture, crypto, golf)?
questions.known: Answered by the scheduled collector (runs 2026-11-20): one paginated pass over GET /events?status=open&with_nested_markets=true aggregates per-event contract volume and last price; ranking = sum(volume_fp x last_price_dollars), labeled an estimate because the API reports no dollar-volume field.
questions.missing: An exchange-reported dollar-volume definition (none exists in the public API).
questions.how: Keep the labeled estimate (implemented) or agree an alternative definition; see suggestion SG-3B-06.

questions.question: Are there live gas-price events on the demo exchange, and how do resolved gas events get tracked?
questions.known: No live gas events existed at collection time (2026-11-20); the collector therefore sweeps settled markets of the officially documented gas series (KXAAAGASM) with per-series quotas; 50 resolved gas markets recorded (e.g. 'Will average gas prices be above $4.18?' resolved YES, finalized 2026-10-31).
questions.missing: None for this question; the series exists officially and settles markets.

questions.question: Can the visitor's browser fetch the demo API directly (CORS)?
questions.known: Yes - verified live: GET /exchange/status returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin: https://karagemop466-tech.github.io. Probe recorded every run in data/cors_test.json. This resolves the earlier F1 flag.
questions.missing: WebSocket handshake behavior from a browser remains unverified (auth-header handshake).
questions.how: Run a one-off browser WS test on the live site before enabling seconds-level chart granularity.

questions.question: What is needed to activate the implemented demo portfolio/trade tracking?
questions.known: Pipeline (signed requests Ed25519/RSA-PSS per docs, portfolio snapshot, order placement with client_order_id dedup, $1-per-winning-contract PnL) is implemented and offline-tested (11 tests) but unverified live: no demo-account credentials exist in this environment; sign-up at demo.kalshi.co requires human registration.
questions.missing: Repository secrets KALSHI_DEMO_API_KEY_ID and KALSHI_DEMO_PRIVATE_KEY (demo env only).
questions.how: Owner creates a demo account and API key, adds the two secrets; the 'Demo trade / portfolio' workflow then populates data/portfolio.json and data/trades.json.
